notes: Exploring one island to find ten hidden chests is a scavenger hunt in the plainest sense, so this is Adventure on world-open - one contiguous map searched in whatever order the player likes - with no second genre doing any work, since there is no combat, no course and no economy. Kept the Scavenger Hunt preset's collectible-nodes for the ornate chests and alcove-secret for the overgrowth, rock clefts and coves that make them findable rather than merely placed, and dropped tracker-quest because the compass and the found-counter are HUD elements with no geometry to build. Added terrain-relief for the stated 3D terrain island, which is what pushes the route to P0 with tiered elevation and nothing overhanging, and water-body for the sea ringing the island, bent to a boundary the player does not swim, so its CHECK resolves clean. Decided without a user: a tropical pirate island a few minutes across, ten chests, no interiors or caves requested so there is no P3, and the compass, counter and completion message left to mechanics and UI.
